question: The amount on a sum of ₹7,700 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹7,700

Rate (r) = 10%

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

**Calculations:**

A = 7700(1 + 10/100)²

⇒ A = 7700 × (110/100)²

⇒ A = 7700 × (11/10) × (11/10)

⇒ A = 77 × 121

⇒ A = 9317

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
